translations.{magnitude} mag · {date} · {observer}. S: {magnitude} mag · {date} · {observer}. One measurement, not a prediction.
translations.Osservazioni della luminosità cometaria: Comet brightness observations · No account required
translations.%1 osservazioni · %2 comete negli ultimi: %1 observations · %2 comets in the last 14 days
translations.Aggiornamento automatico ogni 24 ore in: Automatic background updates every 24 hours. Recent, consistent series adjust short-term brightness and therefore selection, useful nights and recommended instruments. Insufficient or conflicting data retain the JPL model.
translations.Le stime visuali e quelle CCD equivalent: Visual estimates and CCD visual-equivalent estimates remain separate. The correction expires within 72 hours of the last observation used; it neither predicts outbursts nor guarantees visibility.
translations.Dati: COBS e osservatori contributori ·: Data: COBS and contributing observers · CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Noncommercial use; NightScope data adaptations use the same licence. The code remains under MPL 2.0.
translations.Nessuna osservazione recente utilizzabil: No usable recent observations; the JPL model is retained.
translations.Serie visuali e strumentali discordanti;: Conflicting visual and instrumental series; the JPL model is retained.
translations.Luminosità discordante o variabile; rest: Conflicting or variable brightness; the JPL model is retained and needs checking in the field.
translations.Osservazioni troppo datate per corregger: Observations are too old to adjust the prediction; the JPL model is retained.
translations.Dati omogenei insufficienti per corregge: Insufficient comparable data to adjust the prediction; the JPL model is retained.
translations.{offset} mag da {count} campioni osserva: {offset} mag from {count} observer/day samples, {observers} observers ({method}). Until {date}; afterwards, JPL model.
translations.circa {minimum}-{maximum} mag · stima co: about {minimum}-{maximum} mag · estimate adjusted with COBS
translations.Selezione, notti utili e strumento tengo: Selection, useful nights and instruments account for the adjusted brightness only within its validity period. The margin is precautionary, not a visibility guarantee or an outburst prediction.
translations.Metodi: {methods}. Filtri e aperture dif: Methods: {methods}. Different filters and apertures are neither averaged together nor equated with the eyepiece view.
translations.COBS e osservatori contributori · CC BY-: COBS and contributing observers · CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 · NightScope analysis
translations.Notti vicine al massimo (±1 giorno UT),: Nights near the maximum (±1 UT day), not the entire activity period. Local times: {zone}.
translations.Il massimo IMO resta una data prevista,: The IMO maximum remains a predicted date, not an exact instant. The local window describes sky geometry, not a meteor peak or guaranteed weather.
translations.Buio astronomico assente nelle notti ana: No astronomical darkness during the analysed nights.
translations.Radiante sotto 15° durante il buio astro: The radiant stays below 15° during astronomical darkness on the analysed nights.
translations.Nessun intervallo continuo di almeno 30: No continuous interval of at least 30 minutes meets the observing thresholds.
translations.Le finestre calcolate sono terminate o r: The calculated windows have ended or fewer than 30 useful minutes remain.
translations.Sotto l'orizzonte per tutta la finestra: Below the horizon throughout the window
translations.Presente almeno in parte; illuminazione: Above the horizon for at least part of the window; illumination up to {value}%
translations.Radiante interpolato dalla tabella annua: Radiant interpolated from the annual IMO table.
translations.Radiante approssimato alla posizione del: Radiant approximated by its position at the IMO maximum; drift data do not cover the entire window.
translations.Buio astronomico, radiante almeno a 30°: Astronomical darkness, radiant at least 30° high, and Moon below the horizon or no more than 25% illuminated. Weather assessed separately.
translations.Buio astronomico e radiante almeno a 15°: Astronomical darkness and radiant at least 15° high; low altitude or moonlight limits observation. Weather assessed separately.
translations.Finestra più ampia, con limiti di altezz: Wider window, with altitude or Moon limitations
translations.Altre finestre astronomiche vicine al ma: Other astronomical windows near the maximum
translations.Previsioni non disponibili per questa fi: Forecast unavailable for this window; check again nearer the date.
translations.Previsioni parziali; meteo utilizzabile:: Partial forecast; usable weather: {windows}. Missing hours have not been assessed.
translations.Meteo sfavorevole nella finestra astrono: Unfavourable weather during the astronomical window according to the available forecast.
translations.Previsioni parziali: nessuna apertura me: Partial forecast: no usable weather interval in the covered hours; missing hours have not been assessed.
translations.Limite dell'analisi: il periodo potrebbe: Analysis limit: the period may continue
translations.Orari suggeriti considerando visibilità: Suggested times based on visibility and weather
translations.Orari suggeriti per il meteo previsto: r: Times based on the forecast: check again before observing
translations.Luna luminosa: disturbo se sopra l'orizz: Bright Moon: interference above the horizon varies by target.
translations.Disturbo moderato, se visibile; varia co: Moderate interference if above the horizon; varies by target.
translations.Previsioni orarie della notte non dispon: Hourly forecasts for the night are unavailable.
translations.Condizioni variabili: sono previste solo: Variable conditions: forecast opportunities need checking.
translations.Gli orari suggeriti richiedono conferma: Check the weather before observing at the suggested times.
translations.Massima altezza intorno alle %1. Questa: Maximum altitude around %1. This window only considers altitude; the night plan also considers weather.
translations.Data indicativa dalla tabella annuale IM: Approximate date from the annual IMO table; not an exact instant or a local visibility forecast. Additional peaks are not imported.
translations.Da valutare con buio, radiante, Luna e m: Assess using local darkness, radiant, Moon and weather
translations.Il tasso ZHR si riferisce a condizioni i: ZHR describes ideal conditions, not the number of meteors actually visible from your location.
translations.Notti di osservabilità stimata, non una: Estimated observing nights, not a continuous window or a guarantee of visibility. Check the weather for each night.
translations.La finestra raggiunge il limite del peri: The window reaches the end of the analysed period and may extend beyond it.
translations.La cometa supera le soglie locali di alt: The comet meets the local altitude, darkness, solar elongation and moonlight thresholds. Detection also depends on the sky, equipment and actual brightness.
translations.Riferimento di elongazione e dati lunari: Reference time for elongation and Moon data
translations.Stima favorevole ai dettagli fini; verif: Estimate favours fine detail; check at the eyepiece
translations.Seeing stimato: {seeing}. Verificare la: Estimated seeing: {seeing}. Check image stability at the eyepiece.
translations.Altezza massima nel periodo analizzato: Maximum altitude in the analysed period
translations.Dimensione apparente almeno al 95% del m: Apparent size at least 95% of the estimated maximum near opposition, with altitude above 15° for at least one hour. Check the weather.
translations.Separazione entro {degrees}°, entrambi s: Separation within {degrees}°, both above 15° for at least one hour. Closest approach is not the only opportunity; check the weather.
translations.Le date indicano notti favorevoli, non v: These dates indicate favourable nights, not continuous visibility.
translations.Nessun periodo favorevole secondo le sog: No favourable period meets the local thresholds; any shorter observing window shown still applies.
translations.Tre o più pianeti entro 6° fra ogni copp: Three or more planets within 6° of every other member, simultaneously above 15° for at least one hour.
translations.Quattro o più pianeti luminosi contempor: Four or more bright planets simultaneously above 15° for at least one hour; spread across the sky, not necessarily close together.
translations.Binocolo o basso ingrandimento; verifica: Binoculars or low magnification; check the field of view.
translations.Occhio nudo; i pianeti non sono tutti ne: Naked eye; the planets do not all fit in the same field of view.
translations.Previsioni variabili: non è necessario a: Forecasts can change: there is no need to wait for the peak if the weather is already good.
translations.Sole sotto −18°; orari locali della nott: Sun below −18°; local times for the selected night.
translations.Effemeridi non disponibili: calcoli astr: Ephemerides unavailable: astronomical calculations and the observing plan are disabled.
translations.Aggiornamento del catalogo città - {rows: Updating the city catalogue - {rows} rows processed
translations.Seleziona i filtri presenti nel disposit: Select the filters built into the device. NightScope mentions dual-band in nebula guidance; the dark filter describes automatic calibration.
translations.Scrivi nomi brevi separati da punto e vi: Enter short names separated by semicolons, for example H-alpha; OIII.
translations.Il target resta sotto 30° anche al culmi: The target remains below 30° even at culmination: this is low for deep-sky imaging and reduces contrast and data quality.
translations.La stima supera il limite di pianificazi: The estimate exceeds the 15 h planning limit: the displayed value is a cumulative lower bound across multiple nights, not a prescribed duration.
translations.L'integrazione totale è la somma delle p: Total integration is the sum of usable light frames and can be spread across multiple nights. The times are planning ranges, not a camera calibration.
translations.Accesso opzionale ai dati VIIRS e AOD: Optional access to VIIRS and AOD data
translations.Crea l'account Earthdata, conferma l'e-m: Create an Earthdata account, confirm the activation email, and sign in.
translations.Apri Modifica profilo e compila tutti i: Open Edit Profile and complete every field, including those marked optional: organization, affiliation, user type, and study area. Enter truthful information that applies to you.
translations.In NightScope inserisci nome utente e pa: In NightScope, enter your username and password. Then select Save and Test connection.
translations.Se richiesto, seleziona Autorizza app, s: If prompted, select Authorize app, check every authorization option requested by LAADS OPeNDAP, and confirm with Authorize. Then return to NightScope and repeat the test.
Create an OpenAQ account and sign in.
translations.Apri la pagina dell'account dal menu del: Open the account page from the profile menu and scroll to the API Keys section.
translations.Crea o copia la chiave API. Trattala com: Create or copy the API key. Treat it like a password and do not share it.
translations.In NightScope incolla la chiave, selezio: In NightScope, paste the key, select Save, then Test connection. Setup is complete when the status shows Verified.
translations.Terminatore ben definito: filtro lunare: Well-defined terminator: moon filter recommended for apertures over 100 mm.
translations.La posizione di sistema non è disponibil: System location is unavailable. Choose a city or enter coordinates manually.
System location is unavailable. Try approximate online location?
translations.Usa GeoClue per richiedere la posizione: Use GeoClue to request the system location. Availability and accuracy depend on the location services configured in the Linux distribution.
translations.Cerca città, osservatorio o codice MPC: Search for a city, observatory, or MPC code
translations.Digita una città, un osservatorio o un c: Enter a city, observatory, or MPC code.
translations.Le dimensioni del sensore e il passo pix: Sensor dimensions and pixel size must be greater than zero.
translations.Il frame rate deve essere maggiore di ze: Frame rate must be greater than zero.
translations.Il ΔT massimo sotto ambiente deve essere: Maximum cooling ΔT below ambient must be greater than zero.
translations.Il backfocus deve essere maggiore di zer: Back focus distance must be greater than zero.
translations.Compila tutti i campi video oppure lasci: Complete all video fields or leave them blank.
translations.I valori video devono essere maggiori di: Video values must be greater than zero.
translations.Camera assegnata al profilo. Le raccoman: Camera assigned to the profile. Visual recommendations remain unchanged.
translations.Camera rimossa dal profilo. Le raccomand: Camera removed from the profile. Visual recommendations remain unchanged.
translations.Filtro solare a tutta apertura disponibi: Full-aperture solar filter available for {name}. Visual recommendations remain unchanged.
translations.Filtro solare a tutta apertura non dispo: Full-aperture solar filter unavailable for {name}. Visual recommendations remain unchanged.
translations.Questo elemento è utilizzato da uno o pi: This item is used by one or more profiles.
translations.Migliore combinazione disponibile nel pr: Best available combination in the active profile
translations.Il ritaglio e il ricampionamento video d: The camera body's video crop and resampling are unverified: field of view and image scale may differ from the still sensor.
translations.Riduttore assegnato, ma compatibilità no: Reducer assigned, but compatibility is not configured: it will remain excluded from visual and photographic recommendations until you link at least one telescope.
translations.Riduttore assegnato, ma non collegato a: Reducer assigned, but not linked to a telescope in the active profile: it will remain excluded from visual and photographic recommendations for this profile.
translations.Compatibilità non configurata — escluso: Compatibility not configured — excluded from recommendations
translations.I telescopi del profilo attivo sono most: Telescopes in the active profile are shown first. Without at least one exact link, the reducer remains in the catalogue but is not used in visual or photographic recommendations.
translations.Acquisisci molte pose e sommale; regola: Capture and stack multiple sub-exposures; adjust gain or ISO with field tests without exceeding the stated conservative limit.
translations.Registra più clip separate e seleziona i: Record multiple separate clips and select the best frames during stacking.
translations.Durata e FPS sono intervalli di pianific: Duration and FPS are planning ranges, not an acquisition calibration.
translations.Il frame rate deriva dal massimo di cata: The frame rate is based on the full-resolution catalog maximum; duration and FPS are not guaranteed performance.
translations.Il frame rate è un obiettivo per il targ: The frame rate is a target goal; duration and FPS are not guaranteed performance.
translations.Backfocus richiesto: {required} mm · spa: Required back focus: {required} mm · estimated remaining optical spacing: {remaining} mm
translations.Il backfocus della camera supera di {ove: The camera back focus exceeds the reducer's required distance by {overrun} mm.
translations.Il target non entra interamente nel camp: The target does not fit entirely within the sensor field of view; frame a region or plan a mosaic.
translations.L'inquadratura è stretta: lascia margine: The framing is tight; leave room for orientation, alignment, and cropping.
translations.Il target è sotto l'orizzonte: pianifica: The target is below the horizon; plan the capture during its visibility window.
translations.Il target è basso sull'orizzonte; attend: The target is low above the horizon; wait for a higher altitude to reduce turbulence and atmospheric dispersion.
translations.Il seeing è variabile: acquisisci più cl: Seeing is variable; capture multiple clips and compare the results.
translations.A questa altezza la dispersione atmosfer: At this altitude, atmospheric dispersion can reduce detail.
translations.La montatura altazimutale limita la posa: The alt-azimuth mount limits each sub-exposure to control field rotation.
translations.La montatura altazimutale limita le clip: The alt-azimuth mount limits longer clips because of field rotation.
translations.L'inseguimento manuale richiede pose sin: Manual tracking requires very short sub-exposures.
translations.L'inseguimento manuale può richiedere cl: Manual tracking may require shorter, repeated clips.
translations.Il corpo macchina non dichiara la modali: The camera body does not declare Bulb mode; verify the maximum available exposure time.
translations.Il pianeta è debole: bilancia tempo di e: The planet is faint; balance per-frame exposure time and gain instead of pursuing frame rate alone.
translations.La rotazione del pianeta limita la durat: Planetary rotation limits the useful duration of a single clip without derotation.
translations.La camera non raffreddata può richiedere: The uncooled camera may require more frames and careful thermal-noise management.
translations.La luce lunare è forte e può aumentare l: Strong moonlight can increase the required total integration.
translations.La Luna è presente nella finestra del ta: The Moon is present during the target window; check gradients and contrast.
translations.Il moto della cometa può richiedere pose: Comet motion may require shorter sub-exposures or stacking aligned on the nucleus.
translations.Il tipo di montatura non è verificato; u: The mount type is unverified; treat the sub-exposure limit as a conservative value.
translations.Il video del corpo macchina può applicar: Camera-body video may apply compression or rescaling.
translations.Il frame rate disponibile è inferiore al: The available frame rate is below the typical goal for this target.
translations.Questo target non dispone ancora di una: This target does not yet have a reliable imaging policy.
translations.Il Sole viene raccomandato solo con un f: The Sun is recommended only with a certified full-aperture solar filter secured in front of the selected telescope's objective.
translations.Attiva un profilo per costruire una racc: Activate a profile to build an imaging recommendation.
translations.Aggiungi almeno un telescopio al profilo: Add at least one telescope to the active profile to build an imaging train.
translations.Aggiungi una camera astronomica o un cor: Add an astronomy camera or camera body to the active profile.
translations.Verifica telescopio, camera e compatibil: Check the telescope, camera, and compatibility of the assigned focal reducers.
translations.La combinazione è stata valutata, ma i d: The combination was evaluated, but the available data is insufficient for a reliable capture plan.

DataProvidersPage.Importa il calendario IMO dell'anno corr: Import the current year's IMO calendar
DataProvidersPage.Fonti esterne, calendari scaricati e acc: External sources, downloaded calendars and optional access.
DataProvidersPage.Calendario annuale degli sciami meteoric: Annual meteor shower calendar · No account required
DataProvidersPage.Download automatico una sola volta per a: Downloaded automatically once per year, after startup. At the change of year, the previous calendar is removed only after the new one has been downloaded and validated. IMO dates remain predictions, not guarantees of observability.
DataProvidersPage.PDF non valido o di un altro anno. Il ca: Invalid PDF or wrong year. The existing calendar has been preserved.
DataProvidersPage.Il calendario dell'anno corrente non è d: The current year's calendar is unavailable. Another automatic attempt will be made within 24 hours; approximate recurring dates are used meanwhile. You can import the original IMO PDF if you have already downloaded it.

EquipmentProfilesPage.Inventario visuale e fotografico del pro: Visual and imaging equipment assigned to the active profile
EquipmentProfilesPage.Solo filtri solari certificati fissati d: Only certified solar filters secured in front of the objective; never use eyepiece solar filters.

EquipmentCamerasPage.Camere assegnabili ai profili, predispos: Cameras assignable to profiles, ready for the future imaging recommendation engine
EquipmentCamerasPage.FPS alla risoluzione video indicata: FPS at the specified video resolution
EquipmentCamerasPage.Eliminare la camera astronomica dal cata: Delete the astronomy camera from the catalog?
EquipmentCamerasPage.Eliminare il corpo macchina dal catalogo: Delete the camera body from the catalog?
